prompts.text: Name a green fruit or vegetable
Name a city in South America, Central America, Mexico, or the Caribbean (towns count too)
Name a musician who has passed away and still has at least 1 million monthly listeners on Spotify
Name a player who won a league title in the NBA, Premier League, La Liga, AFL, or IPL (women’s equivalents count too)
Name a protagonist from a book that sold at least 500,000 copies (no manga)
